original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: A broad stone-footed toll arch carries a heavy chain, hooked tally bell, unequal lock plates, and one ember lantern.
An asymmetric timber post raises a hooded beacon above a blank ledger plate, offset paddles, hanging weights, and forked crown.
A half-moon skiff rib carries a huge hide drum, crooked keel, chained beaters, reed fins, and hooked ferry weight.
A leaning wicker cage shelters three luminous marsh fungi beneath a crescent hood, uneven handles, clay drum, and root hook.
A faceted prism obelisk twists inside three broad light rails beneath an offset sunwheel and two crystal plumbs.
A huge oval survey lens rests on a forked tripod with a sighting needle, calibration vanes, mirror flap, and prism weight.
A living root arch carries three hollow seed-pod resonators, a spiral loam horn, leaf chimes, and braided feet.
A broken cartwheel grows through a thorn crown beside an axle drum, hanging bark tallies, hooked tow branch, and leaf pennants.
A squat assay gantry balances a blank seal plate against a toothed wheel, uneven weights, broken measuring arm, and pressure feet.
A compact mine headframe holds a huge pressure bell, lift chain, descending gauge pipes, ore skip, and warning hammer.
A sharply folded crescent fog sail rises beside a boarding hook, mistglass signals, lantern cage, and coiled deck rope.
An inverted ship-keel rib carries a cracked sounding bell, long plumb hook, tideglass floats, rope knots, and forked finial.
A brick route kiln supports blank charter slates beneath a feather-shaped iron chimney and curled brass paper rail.
A narrow river gate carries seven visibly different locks, a broken counterweight, chain loops, and one hooded lantern.
A chained marsh drum bears a split reed-boom arm, bone beaters, hooked float cages, and a muddy keel foot.
A crooked reed lectern holds blank wax leaves beside a crescent water gauge, clay plumb, and flood markers.
An asymmetric radiant frame carries five crystal chimes, a split sundial, diagonal striker, and prism plumbs.
Four staggered prism blades rise from a stepped base above a mirrored rail, crossing rods, and diamond lens.
A living-root frame surrounds an empty seed cradle with leaf mirrors, a bark pointer, graft vials, and clawed feet.
Three unequal seed pods circle on branch orbits above a leaf vane, root plumb, antler braces, and vine tripod.
A mobile casting gantry suspends an unfinished faceted bell beside a pouring arm, mold clamps, and warning hammer.
A low assay station carries a tilted balance scale, ash cups, calibration arc, chain weights, and furnace pot.
A bare harbor mast raises a broad white clapperless bell with a crescent sail rib, pendants, and anchor hook.
A crooked harbor mooring bears opposing wind fins, a rope drum, direction discs, storm lantern, and split anchor base.
A squat black-iron cantilever spans a molten quench basin beneath nested gauges, a cracked bell, hooked counterweight, and four riveted feet.
A tall asymmetric stamp press carries a broad blank brass plate, three unequal counterweights, steam vent, toothed flywheel, and split iron base.
A curved antler-and-reed toll arch carries a huge ivory tusk bell, heavy chain, blackwater lantern, three tally hooks, and muddy stone feet.
A low hide-drum command desk carries a chain-bead abacus, three blank wax tally leaves, crescent reed pennant, ferry weight, and root tripod.
An ink-black sail mast carries a broad blank hanging scroll, clapperless salt bell, three white quill vanes, anchor hook, and bone feet.
A ribbed ship-cabinet reliquary holds blank tideglass tablets, a half-submerged sounding bell, rope drawers, pale lantern, and keel base.
A gnarled root-and-antler dais supports a huge hide verdict drum, reed-tooth crown, three bone beaters, hanging moon seals, and clawed feet.
A crooked reed beacon carries a spiral wake fan, drowned-blue flame cage, hanging bone plumbs, crescent hook, and root-and-mud base.
An asymmetric ivory survey instrument carries nine unequal prism rays, a huge oval lens, diagonal sighting rod, crystal plumbs, and forked tripod.
A tall faceted sundial carries two offset floating rings, a black prism shadow blade, diamond lens, calibrated arc, and stepped ivory base.
